mapper.select: SELECT outpatient_volume AS outpatientVolume, doctor_ratio AS doctorRatio, reception_rate AS receptionRate, prescription_rate AS prescriptionRate, record_rate AS recordRate, review_rate AS reviewRate, execution_rate AS executionRate FROM TR_INET_HOSP_OV WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}
SELECT item_name AS itemName, current_value AS currentValue, last_value AS lastValue, growth_rate AS growthRate FROM TR_INET_HOSP_OP WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY item_name
SELECT category, current_value AS currentValue, last_value AS lastValue FROM TR_INET_HOSP_BIZ WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY category

SELECT rank_num AS rankNum, dept_name AS deptName, current_month AS currentMonth, last_month AS lastMonth, growth_rate AS growthRate FROM TR_INET_HOSP_DEPT_RNK WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY rank_num
SELECT rank_num AS rankNum, doctor_name AS doctorName, dept_name AS deptName, title, current_month AS currentMonth FROM TR_INET_HOSP_DOC_RNK WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY rank_num
SELECT category, data_value AS dataValue FROM TR_INET_HOSP_GRW WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} ORDER BY category

SELECT stat_month AS statMonth, outpatient_volume AS outpatientVolume, doctor_ratio AS doctorRatio, reception_rate AS receptionRate, prescription_rate AS prescriptionRate, record_rate AS recordRate, review_rate AS reviewRate, execution_rate AS executionRate FROM TR_INET_HOSP_OV WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TR_INET_HOSP_OV t USING (SELECT #{statMonth} AS stat_month FROM DUAL) s ON (t.stat_month = s.stat_month) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET outpatient_volume = NVL(#{outpatientVolume}, outpatient_volume), doctor_ratio = NVL(#{doctorRatio}, doctor_ratio), reception_rate = NVL(#{receptionRate}, reception_rate), prescription_rate = NVL(#{prescriptionRate}, prescription_rate), record_rate = NVL(#{recordRate}, record_rate), review_rate = NVL(#{reviewRate}, review_rate), execution_rate = NVL(#{executionRate}, execution_rate), ext1 = '人工登记', update_time = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( stat_month, outpatient_volume, doctor_ratio, reception_rate, prescription_rate, record_rate, review_rate, execution_rate, ext1, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statMonth}, #{outpatientVolume}, #{doctorRatio}, #{receptionRate}, #{prescriptionRate}, #{recordRate}, #{reviewRate}, #{executionRate}, '人工登记', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
